note: Knowledge base for DanfoAI: LAMATA BRT and rail plus the local danfo, korope, keke and ferry network riders actually use. Community corrections on 0G Chain keep it current.
fareNote: BRT and LAMATA blue-bus fares are the official published fares effective 2 March 2026 (13% adjustment) and are charged exactly by Cowry card. Danfo and keke fares are cash, negotiated, and move with fuel price, traffic and time of day, so they are given as ranges.

tips: Cowry card: needed for BRT, Blue Line, Red Line and LAGFERRY. Buy one at any BRT terminal or rail station (about ₦600–₦1,000) and top up ₦100–₦5,000.
Danfo and korope: pay the conductor in cash, ideally exact change, and confirm the destination the conductor is shouting before you board.
Rush hours: 6–9am towards the Island and 4–8pm back to the mainland — add 30–60 minutes.
Last mile: keke costs about ₦200–₦800 depending on distance. Okada is banned on major roads in many Lagos LGAs, so plan on keke or walking.
Keep your phone and bag out of sight at under-bridge parks, and avoid empty buses that won't tell you the route — that's how 'one chance' works.
